chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Slays a Demigod and Gains the Demon Sect Founder's Protection
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen kills a Tiger demigod with the Eight Aspect Worlds, then faces the Little Li Flying Dagger in a draw. Twenty young elites surround the remaining Tiger family, acting on orders of the legendary Demon Sect Founder.
og_title: A Demigod Falls: Xiao Chen's Greatest Victory and the Demon Sect Founder's Favor
og_description: After slaying a Tiger demigod, Xiao Chen gains the protection of the ancient Demon Sect Founder. Twenty top young experts from East and West side with him, stunning the capital.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen's Epic Win: Demon Sect Founder Bows to Protect Him
twitter_description: Xiao Chen kills a demigod and earns the backing of the Demon Sect Founder, causing twenty young elites to surround the Tiger family.
